---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement for SatRoverWatch
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What would you like SatRoverWatch to do?

Describe your idea in your own words. You do not need to be a programmer or know how SatRoverWatch is implemented.

## Why would this be useful?

Tell us how this feature could help satellite rovers, satellite operators, or the Amateur Radio Satellite Community.

## How might it work?

If you have ideas about how the feature could work, describe them here. This is optional — an idea alone is enough.

## Anything else?

Add any examples, screenshots, links, operating experiences, or other information that might help explain the idea.

Thanks for helping improve SatRoverWatch!
